title: Research audit: exact widths for all 255 P104 survivor projections (seed 67, no new kappa)
head: 4403baa77a7a598ea0d64b73428748c8f5693954
body:
## Status
Mathematical audit and finite proof extension, with no new kappa. This contribution builds on merged PR #1125 and its term-preserving terminal-read interface. It does not change the selected frontier.

## Result
Classifies all 255 nonempty survivor masks in 21 exact cube-automorphism orbits using antichain and chain-cover dual certificates. Removing two opposite cube vertices yields width 20; other two-vertex removals yield width 18. For three through seven removed terms, the widths are 10, 6, 3, 2, 1. The inherited inequality L >= q + 2 max(0, width(F_K) - P_K) now has exact width inputs for all deletion counts.

## Verification
Run from repository root:
python3 -I -B research/p104-all-projections-seed67/verify.py
Expected PASS_P104_ALL_PROJECTIONS orbits=21 subsets=255 negative_controls=10 no_new_kappa

Optional SciPy independent matching checker:
python3 -I -B research/p104-all-projections-seed67/independent_scipy.py
Expected PASS_SCIPY_INDEPENDENT_MATCHING subsets=255 antipodal_pairs=4 no_new_kappa

## Provenance, scope and credit
Source certificate fixed to merged PR #1125 head 9f7c0679d64bab954b7161d8586dc626a59b92ee and blob 9a2cd574df48361579167e39aa6198f39059f70c. Research branch based on ce7ad1b6ab09452c3478723a2e96ed5ff212dc08; source snapshot is not an all-size proof. No changes to upstream/ or selected frontier. Prepared for @Chrisbryan17 with substantial GPT-6 assistance. Ali Romman authored the precursor #1125 theorem; earlier related work is #1071 and #968. Apache-2.0. Detailed proof, certificates, controls, and original PR body are in research/p104-all-projections-seed67/.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
